reason: Provides image recognition for text-only DeepSeek models by sending local images through a browser-automated DeepSeek web vision CLI; human review is warranted because it executes a local subprocess, handles a session token, and transfers images to an external service.

summaries.zh: 通过浏览器自动化调用 DeepSeek 网页视觉模式，将本地图片发送给外部服务并返回图像描述。
summaries.en: Uses browser automation to send local images to DeepSeek’s web vision mode and return textual image descriptions.

capabilities: Reads local image files from supplied paths
Invokes a local Python CLI through a subprocess service
Uses browser automation to access DeepSeek web vision
Uploads image content to DeepSeek's web endpoint
Uses a locally stored DeepSeek session token
